license.changes: Lossless rectangular Bayer extraction and gzip packing only; no normalization, demosaic, alignment, or fusion

source.description: User-supplied forest GCam ZSL burst (HDR+ port tuning on 25080RABDG), oldest 30 of 32 frames
limitations: Camera2 HAL row/pixel strides, camera/physical IDs and physical sensor-buffer origin unavailable in GCam payloads.
Sensor timestamps are GCam filename T-field nanoseconds (ZSL sensor clock, ~33 ms cadence), not Camera2 SENSOR_TIMESTAMP.
Coordinates below are the DNG active-array domain; physical HAL origin is unknown.
DNG stored orientation needs 90-degree rotation for display; fixture uses unrotated active-array coordinates.

referenceReason: Real captured middle frame; fixed deterministic fixture reference, not an algorithmically selected optimum
